children: Sun Yuchen said the recent dispute involving him is a routine civil property matter that has already entered judicial proceedings. According to Odaily, he said he respects the court, the legal process, and all of the other party’s rights, and will accept the outcome regardless of the final result.
He also said, "This matter ends with me," and expressed hope that Jing Tian’s future life will no longer be affected by it.

title: Sun Yuchen Says Recent Dispute Is a Civil Property Matter and Has Entered Judicial Proceedings
